title: Z-Axis with Circle Slice of a Sphere
full_prompt: Write a ManimGL script using InteractiveScene that visualizes a 3D sphere sliced by a horizontal plane represented by a circle. Create a 3D coordinate system using ThreeDAxes scaled to width 4. Add a semi-transparent blue Sphere of radius 1 with a white SurfaceMesh of resolution (51, 26) and stroke width 2 (opacity 0.25). Ensure the sphere always sorts to the camera. Create a green Z-axis line from Z=-1 to Z=1 with stroke width 10, and apply depth testing. Add a green TrueDot that tracks the Z-value. Create a red Circle of radius 0.8 with stroke width 10, applying depth testing. Use a ValueTracker initialized at 0.6 to control the Z-position. Add updaters to the green dot and the red circle so that they move along the Z-axis according to the tracker. The red circle's width must dynamically scale to 2.01 * sqrt(1 - z^2) to match the cross-section of the sphere at height z. Reorient the camera frame to (phi=23, theta=70, gamma=0) with a focal point of (-0.06, 0.05, -0.19) and zoom 3.02. Animate the Z-tracker from 0.6 to 0.9 over 4 seconds, then to -0.9 over 8 seconds, and finally back to 0.6 over 6 seconds.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing custom imports or classes like InteractiveScene in standard Manim Community
common_failure_modes.note: Requires ManimGL or custom 3b1b imports. Standard Manim CE will fail on InteractiveScene and TrueDot.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect math formula for circle radius
common_failure_modes.note: The radius of the circle must scale dynamically with sqrt(1 - z^2).
